senses.sense_definition: An acrobat or performer who displays extreme physical flexibility by twisting their body into unusual positions.

examples.text: The circus <w>contortionist</w> amazed the audience by folding herself entirely into a tiny glass box.
Years of disciplined training allowed the <w>contortionist</w> to perform astonishing physical feats on stage.

senses.sense_definition: A person who manipulates or twists words, arguments, or facts in an elaborate way to mislead others.

examples.text: The clever politician acted like a verbal <w>contortionist</w>, bending every fact to avoid answering the direct question.
Critics described the lawyer as a <w>contortionist</w> of language who could defend any dubious claim.
